svg.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento on AWS - reference reconstruction
svg.desc: Two-AZ Magento deployment with DNS, WAF and CloudFront; public and internal load balancers; optional Varnish; EC2 Magento instances; OpenSearch, Redis, Aurora and EFS. Regional multi-AZ services are not independent zonal deployments.
